spine.claim: Creativity looks like a paradox: the most disciplined people are also the most playful.
Creativity is a system of person, domain and field, not a gift.
The field decides what counts as new, so an idea is creative only once it is accepted.
Discipline in a domain and openness in the person must work together.
Creativity is learnable: build the domain, risk the idea, and face the judgment.
